home.title: BakauBase
home.subtitle: Community mangrove conservation tracker
home.legend: Tap a marker to see plot details

step1.title: Plant and pin
step1.body: Volunteers and fishing communities log each planting site with a phone photo and GPS.

step2.title: Check and monitor
step2.body: Follow-up photos update survival. Free Sentinel-2 satellite imagery flags failing plots.

step3.title: Estimate blue carbon
step3.body: A calculator turns species, area and age into estimated carbon stored.

step4.title: Show and share
step4.body: A public dashboard gives NGOs, agencies and sponsors verifiable progress.

policy.intro: BakauBase connects field evidence to widely used sustainability themes.
policy.sdg13Body: Tracks estimated carbon storage and restoration progress.
policy.sdg14Body: Records action protecting coastal and estuarine habitats.
policy.sdg15Body: Monitors survival and threats across restored mangrove sites.
policy.npbdBody: Organises community monitoring evidence relevant to biodiversity restoration.
policy.note: Alignment indicates a contribution area, not certification or formal policy compliance.

dashboardInsights.priorityPlotsNote: At-risk or failing plots should be inspected first.
dashboardInsights.checksDueNote: Schedule a field visit before interpreting survival.
dashboardInsights.unresolvedReportsNote: Reported or under review in the recent incident list.
dashboardInsights.plantingTotalsBody: Seedling totals are the quantities recorded when each plot was created. They are not the current living-tree count.
dashboardInsights.survivalMethodBody: Survival is based on the latest follow-up count. Plots without a check are labelled separately and should not be treated as measured survival.
dashboardInsights.carbonMethodBody: The prototype multiplies surviving trees by age-based species factors and converts tonnes of carbon to CO₂e. Factors are placeholders pending published local values.
dashboardInsights.evidenceMethodBody: BakauBase can retain GPS, photos and review history. This prototype demonstrates the workflow and does not constitute independent verification.
dashboardInsights.satelliteMethodBody: NDVI, NDWI and imagery comparisons are demonstration layers. Live Google Earth Engine processing is not connected in this prototype.

realSites.title: Real places represented on the map
realSites.intro: These destination coordinates identify documented mangrove areas highlighted by Tourism Malaysia.
realSites.kilim: Mangrove forest and limestone-karst landscape on the eastern side of Langkawi.
realSites.matang: Mangrove forest reserve and eco-education area near Kuala Sepetang.
realSites.kinabenuwa: A mangrove ecology park and boardwalk within Labuan's coastal wetland system.
realSites.dataNote: Locations and centre coordinates are real. Planting plots, incidents, survival figures and carbon estimates remain demonstration data.
